# Ai Health Check (Saas33)
> Sydney's leading AI visibility tracking and advisory service for local small businesses.

## Company Details
- Business: Saas33 Pty Ltd
- Service: Ai Health Check (aihealthcheck.com.au)
- Offering: "Get Found on AI" & AI Visibility Tracking
- Location: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
- Official Email: help@saas33.com.au
- Pricing: From A$99/month inc. GST (AI Visibility), A$399/month inc. GST (AI Receptionist)

## Core Capabilities
- Team scanner iPad-first field tool for in-person business audits
- Multi-engine search tracking across ChatGPT (web), Google Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Mode
- Live competitor recommendation analysis
- 18-point rules-based website crawler and schema audit
- Plain-English action plan and PDF generation
- 24/7 AI Receptionist and call answering integration
